improvements.areaName: SEO Meta Description and OG Tags
improvements.suggestion:
<meta name="description" content="Gideon is your Claude-powered AI assistant for trade and business. Get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support. Try three free searches, then join from US$2/day.">
<meta property="og:title" content="GDN AI – Gideon | Your AI Trade & Business Assistant">
<meta property="og:description" content="Claude-powered AI assistant for business owners, traders, and professionals. Instant answers, voice chat, unlimited workspace. Start with 3 free searches.">
<meta property="og:type" content="website">
<meta property="og:image" content="https://gdn.ai/og-image.png">
<meta property="og:url" content="https://gdn.ai">
<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">
improvements.rationale: Search engines display the meta description in results, directly influencing click-through rates. Open Graph tags ensure professional, branded previews when the homepage is shared on LinkedIn, Facebook, or Twitter—key channels for B2B audiences. The copy highlights Claude-powered AI, the free trial, and low entry price without inventing claims, building trust and encouraging clicks.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Meet Gideon — get instant answers, voice chat support, and professional guidance for your business operations. Try three free searches today."
improvements.rationale: This copy immediately communicates what Gideon is (AI assistant), who it's for (trade and business professionals), and the key benefits (instant answers, voice chat, professional support). The subheading includes a clear, low-friction CTA by highlighting the free trial without pressure. Avoids jargon and builds trust by being direct about the offer.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches, you'll be invited to become a GDN AI member. Membership starts at just US$2 per day and gives you unlimited access to Gideon's voice chat, your own members workspace, and professional trade and business support—all powered by Claude. Choose annual billing to save 30 percent.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point for trial users—what happens at the paywall. It reassures prospects by clearly stating the low entry price, reinforces key benefits, and highlights the annual savings, helping convert free users into paying members.
